checks.row_formula: 4 controls + 40 sources + 8 measurement examples + (4 gate prefixes * 60 rules * 40 sources = 9600 matrix examples) + 40 special controls = 9692

accuracy_notes: NESO queue and Clean Power capacity figures were retained at national/system scope and not downscaled to a parcel or London substation.
Gate 1 and Gate 2 semantics were kept distinct; neither was treated as planning permission, completed reinforcement or energisation.
Ofgem's re-baselined Gate 2 programme timetable was not converted into an individual project connection date.
UKPN headroom, transformer-flow, curtailment and Connections Lab evidence was treated as operational or indicative network evidence, not a binding capacity reservation.
Historical UKPN quotation and connection performance averages were not used as forecasts for an individual application.
G100 technical limitation-scheme evidence was not promoted into network approval, planning permission or parcel capacity.
No parcel relation, Future Growth score, business row, connection cost or energisation date was fabricated.
